entities.name: Pathologist
entities.rationale: Drawn as an icon of a doctor/pathologist with a medical cross at the top-left of the diagram.

entities.name: Hospital
entities.rationale: Drawn as a hospital building icon with a cross at the top-right of the diagram.

entities.name: S3 (Images)
entities.rationale: Left green S3 bucket icon with '5TB' label, used to store medical image datasets.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Orange Kubernetes/EKS icon located centrally below the actors, serving as the labelling and inference platform.

entities.name: SageMaker
entities.rationale: Teal SageMaker icon located in the center, used for model training.

entities.name: S3 (Models)
entities.rationale: Right green S3 bucket icon labeled with 'HDS', used to store trained models.

entities.name: FSx
entities.rationale: Bottom-left green FSx icon connected to SageMaker for high-performance I/O training data access.

entities.name: IAM
entities.rationale: Bottom-right red IAM icon connected to SageMaker for security and compliance.
